chunks: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Ali ibn Asbat, from al-Hakam ibn Miskeen, who said: Amr ibn Shimir narrated to us, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying:
The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him), when the crescent of the month of Ramadan appeared, would face the Qibla.

And he would say: 'O Allah, present it to us with security and faith, and safety and Islam, and encompassing well-being. O Allah, grant us its fasting and its night prayer, and the recitation of the Quran within it. O Allah, deliver it to us and accept it from us, and grant us safety within it.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What is the specific dua recited when the crescent of Ramadan appears?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration highlights the prophetic tradition of greeting Ramadan with a comprehensive supplication seeking both spiritual and physical well-being. It underscores the Shia emphasis on preparing for the month through specific du'as that link the arrival of the crescent with the capacity to fulfill its obligations, reflecting the Imam's role in guiding the community's devotional practices.
